quest.title: An Ode to Yonder City
quest.description: Liyue's crisis has settled down, but it has brought a wave of change to the city. The poet Qingzhou would like to capture these shifts in verse...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x150, Mora x20000, Teachings of Prosperity x5, Teachings of Diligence x5, Teachings of Gold x5

talks.objective: Look for poetic inspiration at the south wharf

dialogues.speaker: Hao
dialogues.text: All is well, all is well...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's well?

dialogues.speaker: Hao
dialogues.text: Oh, it's you, Traveler. So, there was a big incident in the city earlier, right?

dialogues.speaker: Hao
dialogues.text: Well, it's well that nothing untoward happened afterward... And more importantly, it's well that all the food stalls in the city are still open.

dialogues.speaker: Hao
dialogues.text: I mean, what would become of all those delicacies I enjoyed otherwise...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Ah, so it's about eating, then...

dialogues.speaker: Hao
dialogues.text: Hey, don't you look down on it. The quickest way to know if a place is good or not is to see how its cuisine tastes.

dialogues.speaker: Hao
dialogues.text: Ah, just talking about this is making me hungry again. Maybe I should go get a little something...

talks.objective: Look for poetic inspiration at Bubu Pharmacy

dialogues.speaker: Fan Er'ye
dialogues.text: The more I hear of this opera, the less I understand it...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is something wrong?

dialogues.speaker: Fan Er'ye
dialogues.text: Why, hello there, Traveler. Well, here's the problem: Heyu Tea House has released a few new operas lately.

dialogues.speaker: Fan Er'ye
dialogues.text: But they're— Well, they're most lively, that's for sure. But I do not quite comprehend them, or how the young people seem to enjoy it so very much.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: And how do you feel about that?

dialogues.speaker: Fan Er'ye
dialogues.text: That's a good question. Personally, I don't mind hearing some old classics. They're what I'm used to, after all.

dialogues.speaker: Fan Er'ye
dialogues.text: But at the same time, Liyue Harbor is undergoing so many changes. A few new operas seem to fit the reigning mood just fine, too.

dialogues.speaker: Fan Er'ye
dialogues.text: *sigh* Still, these changes feel all too swift. The old operas haven't played in a while. I wonder what Rex Lapis would— No, let us not speak of that...

talks.objective: Look for poetic inspiration near Yujing Terrace

dialogues.speaker: Qingzhou
dialogues.text: What have you learned, my liege?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: A fair bit.

dialogues.speaker: Qingzhou
dialogues.text: Oh, verily? Please, do share.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: There are lots of dogs by the south wharf.

dialogues.speaker: Qingzhou
dialogues.text: Oh, good, good. Most lively indeed.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: The Bubu Pharmacy hosts many finches nearby.

dialogues.speaker: Qingzhou
dialogues.text: Finches, yes... A sign of peaceful times. Lovely poetic imagery.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Some only care for eating...

dialogues.speaker: Qingzhou
dialogues.text: Haha, there is nothing wrong with that. Eating is one of the prime needs and joys of life — especially in a city such as Liyue Harbor.

dialogues.speaker: Qingzhou
dialogues.text: Yes, this too is quite fascinating. I will record this. It may yet be of use.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Some feel that things are changing too quickly.

dialogues.speaker: Qingzhou
dialogues.text: Hmm, that too is as we should expect. To some, Liyue must almost seem to be shedding its skin with every passing day. Even I find it hard to keep up or accept every single shift...

dialogues.speaker: Qingzhou
dialogues.text: But this is a matter most broad — I fear that a single poem may not capture it adequately. Still, I shall write it down.

dialogues.speaker: Qingzhou
dialogues.text: That should do for now. I see that I chose wisely in seeking your aid, my liege.

dialogues.speaker: Qingzhou
dialogues.text: I believe that this will add at least a few new entries to my next anthology.

dialogues.speaker: Qingzhou
dialogues.text: Ah, yes, apart from some material goods, I have also prepared a little gift for you. Please take it as thanks for your succour.

dialogues.speaker: Qingzhou
dialogues.text: Once my new anthology is published, you may exchange this signature for a free copy.

talks.objective: Talk to people at Yujing Terrace
Talk to people at Yujing Terrace

dialogues.speaker: Fan Er'ye
dialogues.text: *sigh* How quickly this city changes...

dialogues.speaker: Hao
dialogues.text: Ah, all this talking is making me hungry. What should I eat...

dialogues.speaker: Qingzhou
dialogues.text: Truly, Liyue feels... a little too different.
